svg.title: A replay claim survives replacement but does not prove the business result
svg.desc: The local SQLite claim for nonce N persists across same-machine backend replacement, so a copied receipt gets 403. A separate failure after recording the claim returns 503; retry gives 403 while the business outcome is unknown. This model does not call a payment provider or prove AWS durability.
svg.text: Cloud-free lab · one same-machine SQLite file
Backend A claims nonce N → first reply 200
New backend B reads N as used.
A new signed request still returns 200.
Record claim N, then inject failure.
The toy does not call a payment provider.
A claim tracks one token; an operation needs a stable ID,
result record and reconciliation. This local file does not
prove cross-host durability, AWS policy or real payment.
